name: Beneath the Incandescent Stars: A Collection of Short Femboy Erotic Romances

Meet charming femboys, choose whether their scenes are sweet or steamy, and have plenty of fun along the way! Beneath the Incandescent Stars is a collection of short romantic visual novels, each with its own characters and story.
